t: A low-power STM32 chip family for battery sensors, loggers, and audio gadgets.
steps: Buy a Blues Cygnet from the Blues Shop for 15 US dollars, or a NUCLEO-L476RG from the ST eStore for about 21 US dollars.
Install the free Arduino IDE and add the STM32duino board package.
Plug the board into your computer with a USB cable.
Pick your board in the Tools menu.
Upload the Blink example and watch the light flash.
Flash CircuitPython onto the Cygnet or Swan for live coding over USB.
Add a Blues Notecard later to send readings over the cell network.
meta: Wild Open. From $15. A few stores.
